tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search every research-peptide listing (vendor × peptide × size) and rank by USD per mg, price, vendor verification score or size. Filter by lab testing, stock, payment method, where it ships from and more. Returns listings with the vendor verification score, Finnrick rating and lab-test flags, plus

tools.name: search_vendors
tools.description: Search peptide vendors by verification score (default order; null = insufficient data or unscored, never guessed), Finnrick rating, lab pass rate, payment, where they ship from, how to order and how to contact them (email, phone, WhatsApp, Telegram, socials). Each vendor carries a contact card.

tools.name: get_vendor
tools.description: Everything about one vendor: verification score with every component (weight, points, evidence), score history, independent tests with lab, batch and public record link, contact card, every listing with price per mg, payment, shipping, coupons, how to order.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: How the verification score is computed: what counts as a verifiable certificate, each component with its weight and rule, the scored/insufficient/unscored thresholds, and the latest score changes across vendors.

tools.name: get_peptide
tools.description: One peptide: how many vendors list it, cheapest USD per mg, and independent lab results by vendor.

tools.name: list_peptides
tools.description: Every peptide in the register with vendor and listing counts, lowest USD per mg and lab pass counts.

tools.name: sponsor_vendor
tools.description: Start a sponsorship: $49 pins one vendor above matching results for 30 days, always labelled Sponsored. Returns a CoinPay hosted checkout url; the buyer opens it and pays with any coin or PayPal. Nothing is charged until they pay there.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_vendors · Private data: search_vendors, get_vendor · Public sink: search_vendors.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_vendors · Private data: search_vendors, get_vendor · Public sink: search_vendors

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
